data.name: FORM
data.detailed_description:
Coming Soon


Acerca do jogo

Charm Games brings you FORM, a surreal adventure that unfolds within the confines of the human mind.

Dr. Devin Eli is a brilliant physicist at the global technology mega-conglomerate Mindful Laboratories. Working in seclusion at an atmospheric research facility in the Alaskan wilderness, Dr. Eli is on the brink of uncovering the meaning behind a mysterious signal coming from a secret artifact - The Obelisk.



Playing as the gifted Dr. Eli, you have superhuman powers of geometric visualization - the unintended consequence of a childhood trauma. Use your powers to follow the signal through The Obelisk and explore dream-like memories to unlock puzzles in your own mind. This path could lead you to a new existence…or it could leave you trapped in your past forever.



Charm Games is a small independent studio of industry veterans from Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The games we make are passion projects for our whole team, based on our shared belief that virtual reality can make the impossible possible. Since releasing FORM, we have been humbled by your support and enthusiasm. Please enjoy!

FEATURES


  • Unique puzzles built for tracked motion controllers.
  • Beautiful, transforming environments you can only experience in VR
  • Play at your own pace, no death or timers.
  • Designed for maximum comfort.

---

"...one of the strangest, most intriguing virtual spaces I’ve seen in any VR experience yet." - IGN

"Logic and shapes take the player on a surreal trip." - Polygon

data.short_description: Enter a surreal adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. Solve the mystery behind an ancient artifact. Advance through a world that transforms around you. Transcend this existence.

reviews.review:
FORM is a virtual reality puzzle adventure that uses surreal imagery, environmental interaction, and science-fiction mystery to create an experience centered on discovery rather than action. Developed and published by Charm Games, it places the player inside an unusual investigation where scientific experimentation gradually gives way to something more psychological and abstract. Instead of treating virtual reality as an optional presentation method, the game builds its puzzles and environments around physical interaction, making VR an essential part of its identity.

The story follows Dr. Devin Eli, a talented physicist working for Mindful Laboratories at an isolated research facility in Alaska. His current assignment involves investigating a mysterious signal associated with a classified object called The Obelisk. Devin also possesses an extraordinary ability to visualize complex geometric structures, an unusual talent connected to a traumatic experience from his childhood. As his investigation progresses, the distinction between scientific reality, memory, and imagination becomes increasingly difficult to determine. The Obelisk seems capable of reaching far beyond ordinary technology, drawing Devin into strange spaces where fragments of his past coexist with impossible architecture.

FORM handles its narrative with restraint. Rather than constantly interrupting exploration with lengthy explanations, it allows its environments and surreal transitions to carry much of the mystery. This approach creates a persistent feeling that the player is trying to understand something that does not obey conventional rules. The unanswered questions surrounding Devin, his memories, and The Obelisk provide enough motivation to continue, although the story ultimately feels more like an intriguing foundation than a completely developed science-fiction narrative.

Puzzle solving is the central gameplay component, and Charm Games makes effective use of motion-controlled interaction. Players examine objects, manipulate mechanisms, arrange geometric components, recognize patterns, and determine how unfamiliar devices operate. Much of the satisfaction comes from experimentation. A strange object may initially appear incomprehensible, but touching, rotating, opening, or activating its individual components gradually reveals its purpose. This physical approach makes otherwise straightforward puzzles more engaging because the player is actively handling the mechanisms rather than simply selecting solutions from an interface.

The puzzles generally favor accessibility over severe difficulty. There are no traditional combat encounters demanding quick reflexes, and the absence of death or restrictive timers allows the player to investigate each challenge without pressure. This creates an appropriately relaxed rhythm and helps preserve immersion. However, dedicated puzzle enthusiasts looking for extremely demanding logic problems may find the experience relatively forgiving. FORM is primarily interested in delivering the pleasure of discovery, with puzzles functioning as interactive pieces of its surreal world rather than obstacles intended to halt progress for long periods.

The visual presentation is one of the game's greatest strengths. Environments can shift dramatically in scale and structure, transforming what initially appears to be a contained puzzle into something much larger and stranger. Geometric forms, futuristic machinery, abstract landscapes, scientific equipment, and dreamlike imagery combine into a coherent artistic direction. Virtual reality makes these transformations particularly effective because changes occur around the player, producing a stronger sense of scale and presence than the same scenes would likely achieve through a conventional display.

Audio is equally important to the atmosphere. Ambient sounds, mechanical effects, music, and voices help turn abstract environments into believable spaces while reinforcing the uncertainty surrounding Devin's journey. At different moments, FORM can feel peaceful, mysterious, alien, or subtly unsettling without depending on conventional horror techniques. Its audiovisual design consistently supports the impression of entering increasingly remote areas of another person's consciousness.

Comfort also appears to have been an important design consideration. FORM avoids building its appeal around frantic locomotion or constant action. Instead, the player spends considerable time observing the surroundings and interacting with nearby objects. This slower structure complements both the puzzle mechanics and the contemplative atmosphere. It also demonstrates that VR immersion does not necessarily require overwhelming spectacle; sometimes the simple act of reaching toward an impossible object and watching it react can provide the most memorable moment.

Its most noticeable limitation is scope. The concepts surrounding Mindful Laboratories, Devin's unusual abilities, The Obelisk, and the relationship between memory and reality suggest a universe capable of supporting a considerably larger adventure. Just as the mystery becomes particularly interesting, the relatively compact nature of the experience can leave the player wishing its narrative and puzzle systems had been explored more extensively. The conclusion may consequently feel abrupt for anyone expecting a lengthy story with extensive character development and numerous complicated puzzle chains.

Nevertheless, the shorter structure also prevents FORM from becoming repetitive. The experience moves efficiently from one imaginative interaction to another, introducing new visual ideas before previous concepts lose their novelty. There is very little unnecessary content, and the focused pacing makes the adventure feel closer to an interactive science-fiction installation than a conventional puzzle campaign padded for additional playtime.

FORM remains an impressive example of designing specifically for virtual reality. Its strongest qualities come from the relationship between physical interaction, spatial transformation, environmental storytelling, and abstract visual design. The puzzles could have been more challenging and the fascinating narrative concepts deserve greater development, but the game compensates through atmosphere and creativity. Charm Games created an experience that understands how VR can make simple interactions feel extraordinary when the surrounding world convincingly responds to the player's presence.

For players interested in atmospheric science fiction and approachable environmental puzzles, FORM offers a distinctive journey through technology, memory, and impossible geometry. Its brevity prevents it from fully realizing every idea it introduces, yet its focused execution gives the experience a memorable personality. 

Rating: 8/10

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows™ 7 SP1, Windows™ 8.1 or later or Windows™ 10
  • Processador: Intel™ Core™ i5-4590 or AMD FX™ 8350, equivalent or better
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290, equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 3 GB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: SteamVR or Oculus PC. Standing Only

  • Memória: 16 GB de RAM
